responsibility: Defines the ISO Modula-2 coroutine and interrupt interface used by the gm2 runtime: the abstract COROUTINE handle type, interrupt-source and protection-level types, and the API for creating coroutines, transferring control, associating interrupt sources, querying the current coroutine, and changing interrupt protection. It is the specification layer for the scheduler/runtime support implemented alongside RTco and Processes, describing the control-transfer and interrupt-listening operations that other library modules consume.
same_name_distinction: This is the public definition module for COROUTINES: it declares the abstract types and coroutine/interrupt procedures, while the same-stem COROUTINES.mod contains the runtime data structures and low-level RTco/RTint-based implementation of those operations.
